notes: No document in the repository assigns a stable branch ID; `id` and the filename are minted as <weaponId>-<branch-name-kebab-case> per the transcription convention.

Prerequisites, exclusivity, and the two-unit cost model are stated in docs/65-weapon-stat-and-branch-upgrades.md lines 66 and 68; the cost resource and amount for this branch come from this section's heading.
`rules` holds every bullet of the section verbatim with its source line; `effects` is the structured transcription of those same bullets.

rules.text: Removes the four-target pierce limit. The lance continues to its current maximum range and may damage every enemy it crosses.
Damage, width, range, cadence, and projectile speed are otherwise unchanged.
Expected effect: approximately +35–70% horde throughput in a dense aligned stream and no direct single-target increase.
